notes: Clawdmeter: works with several paired PCs (the gadget shows the PC you pick; 'Show on the gadget' button in the Clawdmeter tab and the tray). New System screen data: CPU (per core), RAM, GPU (any vendor: AMD, Intel, NVIDIA; 'GPU on the gadget' setting to limit to NVIDIA or hide), system drive and network, sent every 2 s. Needs the matching gadget firmware for the new screens.
